finding: CF-IT-CAME-OUT-OF-BOWMAN (Drew, 2026-08-13, re-affirmed 2026-09-05). Chrome Prospect Autographs (CPA-xx) are 2026 BOWMAN cards (Beckett 2026-bowman-full.csv, productKey 2026-bowman, section "Chrome Prospect Autographs", 87 base + 47 Gold Ink + 39 PackFractor); 2026 Bowman CHROME is a separate, later product whose own Beckett checklist (2026-bowman-chrome.csv, 1197 rows) carries zero CPA-MG / Marconi German rows. The card_catalog fold for the Gold Refractor /50 address already ran on 2026-09-05 (row hiq:baseball:2026:bowman:cpa-mg:gold-refractor:auto:num-50 carries movedFrom: hiq:baseball:2026:bowman-chrome:cpa-mg:gold-refractor:auto:num-50, movedAt 2026-09-05T21:20:46Z) -- the old bowman-chrome catalog row no longer exists. But the POOL rows were never relocated: every one of these sold_comps rows still carries cardId (its partition key) at the old bowman-chrome address, even though most already carry the CORRECT hobbyiqCardId pointing at bowman. This list finishes that fold on the partition side. inferSetKeyFromTitle (parseTitleIdentity.service.ts:3550, `if (/bowman\s+chrome/.test(t)) return "Bowman Chrome";`) is a bare regex on the words "Bowman Chrome" appearing anywhere in a title, with no card-number-prefix precedent check comparable to the #1860 Bowman-Draft CPA-DT fix (project_beckett_initials_card_numbers_collide) and no checklist-presence guard -- so every eBay title reading "...Bowman Chrome...CPA-MG..." derives to bowman-chrome even though CPA-MG's number exists only in the sibling bowman product's checklist.
rulings: fromCardId is the row's STORED cardId (the partition key), never its hobbyiqCardId -- this lane repoints BOTH fields to `toCardId` on RELOCATE (relocate-pool-rows-by-list.cjs: 'A moved row carries ONE identity. Both fields land at `to`').

Where the sale's title states an explicit print run and the STORED hobbyiqCardId names an unnumbered address, this list targets the NUMBERED checklist-backed row instead of reproducing the stored (wrong) hobbyiqCardId -- e.g. three Speckle Refractor sales stating /299 in the title move to :speckle-refractor:auto:num-299 (which exists, hobbymonitor-scraped-2026-08-31), not the ingest-auto-seed unnumbered stub.

One entry (tca-ebay::178410615046, Mini Diamond Refractor /100) is EXCLUDED: no hiq:baseball:2026:bowman:cpa-mg:mini-diamond-refractor:auto:num-100 checklist row exists in card_catalog. Absent beats wrong -- this sale stays at its current address pending that checklist gap being closed, and is never minted from the sale itself.

One eBay-title cross-collision (tca-ebay::206470795807, "1997 Skybox Metal Universe - Shannon Sharpe #31") is UNRELATED to this list: it is Case B's football-card collision on a different sport segment and is out of this list's scope.

Every toCardId in this list was point-read against card_catalog on 2026-09-12 and confirmed to exist with source classified checklist-backed (catalogAuthorityOf) EXCEPT the Mini Diamond exclusion above.
Destination catalog rows keep their identity: this list moves SALES only. It never mints, retires, or reslugs a card_catalog row.
